phase_count.reason: deadlift objective (optimization/objective_data/deadlift.py) defines 4 phases; the bundle standard requires 5. Adding a phase changes trajectory content and is a separate follow-up.

coordinate.shoulder_*_adduct.limits_rad.reason: the vendored standard's shoulder_{side}_adduct limits_deg [-30, 180] mirror the anatomical abduction/adduction convention (positive = adduction toward the midline); this model uses the corrected [-180, 30] range (abduction to ~180 deg, adduction capped near 30 deg, Kapandji 2008). Tracked upstream as Repository_Management#2062; the standard itself is not edited here.
